{{Top|ga}} {{Otheruses|327}} {{Youmay|an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]|[[KRONOS-841]] of the [[Droid Gotra]]}} {{Droid |type=Hutt Cartel |image=[[File:KRONOS-327HS-TCWf.png]] |name=KRONOS-327 |homeworld= |birth= |death= |creator= |manufacturer=[[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' |line=[[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] |model=[[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] |class=[[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droid]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' |cost= |length= |width= |height=1.99 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' |mass= |gender= |pronouns=He/him[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |sensor=[[Color/Legends|Red]] |plating=Purple, with white and red markings |armament= |equipment= |affiliation=*[[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] **[[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] }} {{Quote|After all these years, my most ''trusted'' of assassins has finally failed.|Ziro Desilijic Tiure|audio=KRONOS327Failed-TCWf.flac|}} '''KRONOS-327''' was a renegade [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]] [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] belonging to [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the underworld crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Ziro allowed KRONOS to go without a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] for long periods of [[Time/Legends|time]], which granted the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] his own personality and the ability to gain experience from his missions. When one [[Mission to Yout 12|assignment]]—the [[Death/Legends|elimination]] of one of Ziro's rival Vigos on the [[Yout 12|twelfth moon]] of [[Yout/Legends|Yout]]—ended in failure in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], KRONOS returned to [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|Ziro's Palace]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] gave his report, Ziro expressed his disappointment and ordered that the droid be scrapped. KRONOS was subsequently taken away by a pair of fellow IG-86 droids. ==Biography== {{Quote|O Ziro the Hutt, Master of the Hutt Clan on seven systems, I am sorry, Your Highness. It will not happen again.''"
"''I know. Take him away, and use him for spare parts!|KRONOS-327 and Ziro, after the droid's failure on Yout 12|audio=KRONOS327SpareParts-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:KRONOS-327.png|thumb|left|250px|KRONOS-327 reports his failure to Ziro the Hutt.]] KRONOS-327 was an [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] produced by [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]. Obtained by [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], KRONOS was utilized as an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] and a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].{{CSWECite|II|79|IG-86}} Having rarely received a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]], KRONOS was able to gain experience and develop a unique personality. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' KRONOS had been in Ziro's service for years and had earned the Hutt's trust, having [[Death/Legends|killed]] many of the Vigo's enemies. In 22 BBY, as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] raged throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Ziro [[Mission to Yout 12|sent]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to [[Yout 12]], the twelfth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yout/Legends|Yout]], to kill a rival Black Sun Vigo. KRONOS failed to complete his mission, but he did return to Ziro at [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|his master's palace]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] In the throne room of the palace, KRONOS delivered his report to the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and asked for a second chance, believing that he could easily complete the assignment if given another opportunity. Ziro expressed his displeasure in his most trusted [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], and seeing KRONOS as useless, the Hutt activated a secret control that neutralized his weapons and ordered that the droid be used for spare parts. KRONOS, screaming in fear of being dismantled, was then dragged from the chamber by two other IG-86 sentinel droids. ==Characteristics== KRONOS-327 was a Holowan Mechanicals-manufactured IG-86 sentinel droid, part of the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] of combat droids. The droid was utilized by Ziro the Hutt as an assassin and a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter. As with other IG-86s in Ziro's service, KRONOS went large amounts of time without a memory wipe. As a result, the droid was able to gain substantial experience from his missions and even develop his own personality. When KRONOS confronted Ziro following his failure on Yout 12, he asked for forgiveness from his master. As he was being dragged away by two other IG-86s, KRONOS verbally expressed his fear of being dismantled. KRONOS boasted a multi-[[Starship sensor array|sensor suite]] in his head, along with combat programming that aided in his targeting of opponents. He was knowledgeable in military tactics and possessed many features that aided him in his missions—among them, magnetic graspers that clasped onto weapons, and servos that enabled him to move in high gravity. The droid commonly used an underworld [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== KRONOS-327 was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'', published in [[2008]]. In the same year, KRONOS appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], in which he was voiced by [[Corey Burton]]—the same actor who voiced Ziro. KRONOS's numerical designation "327" is yet another occurrence of the number in [[canon]]. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Movie Storybook]]'' ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of KRONOS-327}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Heroes and Villains Flip Book]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *{{FactFile2014|11|IGS 1-4|IG-Series Droids}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=KRONOS-327 |es=KRONOS-327 |hu=KRONOS-327 |nl=KRONOS-327 |pl=KRONOS-327 |pt=KRONOS-327 }} [[Category:Black Sun members]] [[Category:Droids of the Hutt Clan]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:IG-86 sentinel droids]]
